mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Grasset nickel project, Quebec. Exploration-stage nickel asset; entire property covered by airborne magneto-telluric/magnetic/VLF-EM survey (2023); mineralization in disseminated, net-textured and massive sulphides. No production, no revenue; no gold or silver content disclosed.

notes: Nickel explorer; no gold or silver production or reserves disclosed in FY2025. CSE:NIX, OTCQB:NXNIF, Frankfurt:6YR. Formerly Archer Exploration Corp. (CSE:RCHR); renamed NorthX Nickel Corp. effective May 1, 2024 (ticker NIX); VanEck GDXJ still shows the stale name 'Archer Exploration Corp'. Executive Chairman Simon Marcotte. Sold its entire Sudbury Basin nickel/base-metal portfolio to Magna Mining Inc. on July 21, 2025 (definitive agreement Dec 18, 2024); company paid $500,000 to Magna in connection with the Broken Hammer mine closure plan; Ontario Ministry of Mines letter of credit ($481,629) released July 31, 2025. Now focused solely on the Grasset nickel property. Raised $1.3M via 26M subscription receipts at $0.05 (Feb 2025). No mineral reserves or current NI 43-101 resource figures disclosed. All figures in CAD unless noted.
report_title: NorthX Nickel Announces Closing of Sudbury Portfolio Sale, Conversion of Subscription Receipts and Leadership Transition (news release, July 21, 2025)
